title: AI-Governed React 19 Design System Monorepo & Progressive Context Retrieval Architecture
whyParagraphs: Scaling a multi-application React design system with AI coding agents exposes two subtle failure modes: loading entire brand manuals, rejected prototypes, and historical audits into the prompt causes context rot that pulls outputs toward generic SaaS templates; meanwhile, visual tokens and HTML/Figma specs quietly drift away from live component behavior and WCAG accessibility standards.

GÜELGA solves this by combining a modular NPM Workspaces React 19 monorepo with a deterministic L0-L5 Progressive Context Retrieval Policy and automated multi-viewport Playwright + Axe-core release verification.

subsystems.title: 6-Package NPM Workspaces Design System Monorepo (@guelga/*)
subsystems.summary: Typed tokens, styles, SVG icon sprites, tri-lingual locales, and spring physics shared across three React 19 apps.
bullets: Six versioned internal packages (@guelga/tokens, @guelga/styles, @guelga/icons, @guelga/locales supporting EN/ES/AST, @guelga/motion-react, and @guelga/react) establish a single source of truth for primitive and semantic UI contracts.

Those packages power three React 19 applications: @guelga/docs (an interactive Widgetbook and component state parity inspector), apps/web, and apps/fluxu-journey-prototype (implementing a Journey Continuity State Graph across shared layout transitions).

subsystems.title: L0-L5 Progressive AI Context Retrieval Gate & 5-Persona Role Routing
subsystems.summary: Restricts repository context by task phase and isolates generic UI skills from overriding brand authority.
bullets: GUELGA_DESIGN_RETRIEVAL_POLICY_v1.json enforces layered retrieval permissions: agents boot only with L0 (constitution, policy, authority manifest, active ticket extract), fetch targeted L1 design principles and L2 canonical demonstrations, and pause at one of 11 Human Visual Approval Gates before L3 (@guelga/tokens and React APIs) or L4 (QA checks) unlock.

Five isolated role playbooks (brand-strategist, art-director, ui-ux-designer, design-system-engineer, qa-editor) prevent simulated self-approval, while L5 (legacy Ticket 28 history) requires an explicit forensic summons and L6 (dist/, node_modules/, unapproved drafts) stays permanently blocked.

subsystems.title: Deterministic Release & Accessibility QA Pipeline (verify_exploration.sh)
subsystems.summary: Verifies multi-viewport renders, WCAG accessibility, vector geometry, and SHA-256 asset hashes before sign-off.
bullets: Every candidate build runs through automated Playwright desktop and mobile visual captures, Axe-core WCAG accessibility audits, and PDF contact sheet rendering checks.
Cryptographic SHA-256 hash pinning verifies licensed Newsreader and IBM Plex Sans font binaries, while cmp -s guarantees byte-identical vector geometry on approved brand marks.
